_meta.purpose: Contract for one weekly scorecard record (raw inputs; KPIs are derived by tools/kpi.py).

title: Scorecard Entry
description: Raw weekly operating inputs. Never store derived KPIs here.

operator_hours.description: Total hours spent operating the business this week (driving, restocking, admin, scouting).

route_hours.description: Subset of operator_hours spent on physical restock routes.

gross_revenue.description: GBP gross sales across all machines.

cogs.description: GBP cost of goods sold (wholesale cost of items vended).

machine_days.description: Sum of live-machine-days this week (e.g. 5 machines x 7 = 35).

stockout_days.description: Count of machine-days with at least one top-5 SKU empty.

cash_collected.description: GBP physically/cashlessly collected and banked this week.
